gold.user: As a Twilio account user, I want to retrieve a list of all my toll-free phone numbers so that I can manage them effectively.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON array of toll-free phone numbers associated with my account, including details such as the phone number, friendly name, and status.

gold.user: As a Twilio account user, I want to create a new toll-free phone number so that I can use it for my business communications.
gold.ideal: The API should accept parameters for the toll-free number and return a JSON object containing the details of the newly created toll-free phone number, including its SID, friendly name, and status.
